description: Remove the listed pages from a PDF and return the remaining pages in their original order. Use this to drop a cover, blank or sensitive pages; use pdf_extract_pages when it is easier to name the pages to keep. Returns the result written to output_path, or inline as an application/pdf resource when output_path is omitted; an existing file at output_path is overwritten. The source is never modified. Deleting every page fails with no_pages_left.

output_path.description: Path of a .pdf file to write the result to, inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory); an existing file there is overwritten. Omit when running remotely: the PDF is then returned inline as an application/pdf resource for the client to save.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: a path to a .pdf file inside the allowed directories (PDFOPS_ROOT, default the working directory), an https:// URL, or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI. Use a URL or data URI when this server runs remotely (Smithery, hosted gateways) where local paths do not exist.

name: pdf_delete_pages

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

output_path.description: Absolute path written, when output_path was supplied

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource, when output_path was omitted

title: Delete pages from PDF
